mission_01: Min-Max scaling is one of the simplest and most widely used normalization techniques. It transforms features to a fixed range, typically [0, 1], by subtracting the minimum value and dividing by the range (max - min). This is particularly useful for algorithms sensitive to feature scales like neural networks, k-nearest neighbors, and support vector machines. In this mission, you will implement min-max scaling from scratch using pandas operations, gaining a deep understanding of how the transformation works mathematically.
